title: 三模型产物适配：logics 未随产物下发的图片引用剥离
scope: Parser artifact client-validator adaptation for the logics backend; unit-level only. Deployed worker validator kept byte-identical to the client copy. No new live multi-page all-backend run in this increment.

defect.observed: logics backend artifact validation rejected with ValueError: Missing or external parser image: imgs/img_in_image_box_328_184_402_240.jpg
defect.root_cause: logics emits synthetic `imgs/img_in_image_box_<x0>_<y0>_<x1>_<y1>.jpg` placeholder references for detected regions it never crops to files, so those assets are absent from the artifact `assets` list; validate_document rejected the document.
defect.fix: Add _strip_unavailable_images(markdown, declared) applied only for backend == 'logics' before image-reference validation. It removes Markdown/HTML image references whose resolved path is not a declared asset, records a LOGICS_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE warning with the stripped list, and re-derives blocks. Declared references are never stripped; fenced code and srcset violations still fall through to hard rejection.

guards: logics-only: other backends keep strict image-reference rejection
declared asset reference -> kept verbatim (real figures shipped by worker survive)
undeclared reference -> stripped, warning LOGICS_IMAGE_UNAVAILABLE carries count and paths
external URL / absolute / traversal path still raises Missing or external parser image
srcset-bearing HTML tags left for hard rejection
deploy/parser-models/model_artifact.py is byte-identical to the client copy (test_parser_contract_hardening::test_client_and_deployed_artifact_validator_are_byte_identical)

verification.note: test_model_artifact.py 25 passed; the six-file parser/chapter batch 115 passed after syncing the deployed validator.
